newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Rich says SNB sees Swiss franc in tolerable band.
newsitem.headline: Rich says SNB sees Swiss franc in tolerable band.

text.p: Swiss National Bank chief economist Georg Rich said on Monday the Swiss franc was still trading within the range which can be tolerated by the central bank.
Queried by reporters after the dollar rose to a three-year high against the franc on Monday, Rich said he believed the markets would stabilise the exchange rate.

"What is a reasonable foreign exchange rate is within a wide band. I think it is still within that band. It is still in the band we find tolerable," he said, adding his comments applied to both the dollar and mark.
Rich also added that the SNB did not conduct its policy solely on the basis of exchange rates. He also said "I think the exchange rate is at a reasonable level."
Asked about a speech to be delivered here this evening, Rich said he would focus mainly on the chances for a rate increase in Switzerland as opposed to a rate cut.
He said most observers were more concerned with when the SNB will raise rates. "I don't see any special reason why rates should go down further."
